items.exampleEn: I write with my left hand.

items.sentenceEn: Are you ready? It is getting dark.
items.sentenceZh: 你準備好了嗎？天色要暗了。

items.audioEn: These shoes are a nice color, but the size is wrong.
items.audioZh: 這雙鞋的顏色很好看，但尺寸不對。

items.sentenceEn: Turn left at the green building.

items.stemEn: Wait a minute. I am not ____ yet.
Do you have this shirt in a bigger ____?
items.stemZh: 這件襯衫有大一點的尺寸嗎？

items.passageEn: Tom wants a new shirt. He likes blue, but the shop only has green and dark red shirts. He puts on a green one, but it is too small. The woman at the shop is very nice. She says, "Come back on Friday. We will have blue shirts then."
items.passageZh: Tom 想買一件新襯衫。他喜歡藍色，但店裡只有綠色和深紅色的。他穿上一件綠色的，可是太小了。店裡的女士人很好，她說：「星期五再來吧，那時我們就會有藍色的襯衫了。」

questions.questionZh: 店員要 Tom 什麼時候再來？

rubricZh: 問句把 be 動詞放在主詞前面（例如 Are you ready?）
寫 Are you ready to go? 也正確

referenceEn: Her hair is long and dark.
rubricZh: dark 可形容顏色深（例如 dark hair）
可寫，例如 She has long dark hair、Her hair is long and dark 等
